name: buttermilk panna cotta
instructions:
Samin Nosrat's buttermilk panna cotta, adopted as the house panna cotta. The order of operations matters (see notes): hot cream dissolves the sugar, then the gelatin dissolves in the hot mix, then the cold buttermilk/yogurt comes in last to cool it down — no use in heating the yogurt.

=== INGREDIENTS ===

- 1 1/4 cups heavy cream
- 7 tbsp sugar
- 1/4 tsp table salt
- 1 3/4 cups buttermilk or yogurt
- vanilla: Samin uses 1/2 a vanilla bean split lengthwise; I use 1-2 TSP VANILLA EXTRACT
- 1 1/2 tsp gelatin (I do a pack), PRE-BLOOMED in cold water

=== PROCEDURE ===

1. BLOOM the gelatin in cold water.
2. HEAT the sugar, salt, and cream (with the vanilla) until the sugar is dissolved — DON'T SIMMER.
3. ADD THE PRE-BLOOMED GELATIN to the hot mix and stir until dissolved.
4. ADD THE BUTTERMILK/YOGURT — it cools the mixture down; no use in heating it.
5. (Samin: STRAIN the mixture before pouring, to remove gelatin/yogurt clumps.)
6. Pour into a COVERED GLASS CASSEROLE DISH (my way — spoon it out) or oiled ramekins (Samin's way, for unmolding — see notes). Chill until set.

=== VARIANT — GREEK YOGURT (DENSER) ===

When there's no buttermilk/yogurt on hand: 1 CUP GREEK YOGURT instead of the 1 3/4 cups buttermilk. Comes out more like a DENSE MOUSSE/PUDDING — but still good.
notes:
=== SOURCE — SAMIN NOSRAT ===

Samin Nosrat's buttermilk panna cotta, with my swaps: vanilla extract (1-2 tsp) over her split vanilla bean, and a gelatin pack over her measured 1 1/2 tsp.

=== ORDER OF OPERATIONS — HERS IS CORRECT ===

Sugar + salt + cream over heat first (dissolve the sugar, no simmer), THEN the pre-bloomed gelatin into the hot mix to dissolve it, THEN the yogurt/buttermilk to cool it down. No use in heating the yogurt.

=== TOPPINGS — MAGIC SHELL OVER COMPOTE; NO LEMON ===

Samin recommends compote, but I think panna cotta is a great vehicle for [[chocolate-magic-shell]], CRUSHED PEANUTS, COCONUT FLAKES, etc. I don't like adding lemon/zest — it would CLASH WITH A CHOCOLATE TOP, and the chocolate direction is the one I want open.

=== SERVING — SPOON FROM THE DISH, SKIP THE UNMOLDING ===

Samin lines the ramekins with vegetable oil so the panna cotta unmolds upside down after a dip in hot water. I don't really care about this part — happy to just spoon it out of a covered glass casserole dish.

=== STRAINING ===

She recommends straining the mixture before pouring — removes gelatin/yogurt clumps. Worth doing.

=== PREVIOUS LIFE — THE FOUR-LANE PANNA COTTA ===

This file used to be a four-lane plain/chocolate/chocolate-peanut-butter/lemon panna cotta (heavy cream only, no cultured dairy). The chocolate + peanut butter lane was the favorite there — that pairing now lives on as a TOPPING direction (magic shell + crushed peanuts) rather than an in-the-base flavor. Full text in git history.

=== SIBLING RECIPES ===

- [[chocolate-magic-shell]]: the intended topping.
- [[tofu-chocolate-mousse]]: the other set-dairy dessert.
- [[new-york-cheesecake]]: the other cultured-dairy dessert — the tang register this panna cotta joins.
